    Given a treatment ID that does not exist

    When the EvaluateRules activity calls the decision record
    Then the activity times out after 2 seconds and is retried 3 times
    Then the retry ends with the case in the exception queue with an incident and MSG-P7-003
    Given NoPackageInForce is thrown for package "RESTRUCTURE"
    When the EvaluateRules activity runs
    Then the refusal is not retried
